input.topic: how language models use long or noisy retrieved context

gaps.quote: the performance of language model readers saturates far before retriever recall
we are hopeful our work could inspire future research towards a general RALM that is robust to irrelevant context

gap_notes: Models struggle to use information in the middle of long contexts, and reader performance saturates well before retriever recall; the role of architecture, query-aware contextualization and instruction tuning is only studied preliminarily. Robustness to irrelevant retrieved context is shown in-domain, with a general robust retrieval-augmented model left open and the NLI filter discarding relevant passages.
